name: MonarchLoadMore
title: LoadMore
wrapsNative: VStack footer of Text, MonarchButton and MonarchInlineErrorRetry; onAppear for auto-loading
summary: The footer of a paginated list: a Load more button with loading, failure and retry, an end-of-list line, an optional count and announcements.
whenToUse: At the end of a List or LazyVStack that loads pages from a cursor, with a button, or loading on its own when it scrolls into view.
whenNotToUse: For a list that is loaded whole, show nothing. For a first load, use MonarchLoadingState; for a first load that failed, use MonarchErrorState. For new content at the top, use refreshable(action:).
api: init(hasMore: Bool, isLoading: Bool = false, isFailed: Bool = false, loadedCount: Int? = nil, totalCount: Int? = nil, showsCount: Bool? = nil, showsEnd: Bool = true, autoLoads: Bool = false, labels: MonarchLoadMoreLabels = MonarchLoadMoreLabels(), onRetry: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onLoadMore: @escaping @MainActor () -> Void)
struct MonarchLoadMoreLabels { var loadMore, loading, failed, retry, end: String?; var count: (@Sendable (Int, Int?) -> String)?; var loaded: (@Sendable (Int) -> String)? }

options.name: hasMore
options.description: Whether there is another page. False shows the end line.

options.name: isLoading
options.description: A page is being fetched; the button shows progress and ignores taps.

options.name: isFailed
options.description: The last fetch failed; shows the failure with a retry button and pauses auto-loading.

options.name: loadedCount
options.description: The items on screen. Shown in the count; increases are announced.

options.name: totalCount
options.description: The total, when the server knows it.

options.name: showsCount
options.description: Whether the count is shown. By default when loadedCount is given.

options.name: showsEnd
options.description: Whether "That's everything" is shown and announced at the end.

options.name: autoLoads
options.description: Loads the next page when the footer appears on screen; the button stays as the fallback.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings, including the count and the announcement.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Runs when retry is activated. By default onLoadMore.

states.name: idle
states.description: A small secondary Load more button, with the count above it.

states.name: loading
states.description: The button shows a progress indicator and the title "Loading…".

states.name: failed
states.description: "Couldn't load more." with a danger icon and a Retry button; while a retry runs, the button is busy.

states.name: done
states.description: "That's everything" in muted text, or nothing with showsEnd false.

appearance: Centred under the list with vertical padding. The count and the end line are caption text in the muted text colour. The button is a small secondary MonarchButton; the failure is a MonarchInlineErrorRetry in the danger tone.
platformNotes: The web also ships a useLoadMore hook that keeps the cursor and pages; on iOS the app's model keeps them, and the footer only shows the state. Auto-loading uses onAppear inside a lazy container instead of an IntersectionObserver, so there is no root margin: put the footer inside the List or LazyVStack. The web returns keyboard focus to the end line when the button disappears; on iOS VoiceOver focus is not moved. Android shares the name and the options.
accessibility: The button is a standard button with a 44-point touch target; while loading its value is "Loading…".
A failure is a MonarchInlineErrorRetry: the message is read with the danger tone's name and the retry button is separate.
New items are announced ("20 more items loaded."), as are a failure and the end of the list.
The button stays when auto-loading, so VoiceOver and Switch Control users load pages on purpose.
edgeCases: With autoLoads, a page that still leaves the footer on screen loads the next one when loading ends, until the screen is filled.
A failure pauses auto-loading until the retry succeeds.
The plural rules of the built-in count and announcement are English; pass labels.count and labels.loaded for other languages.
